lines:
Deterministic MCP retrieval by explicit overview, scope, search, ids and file/symbol bindings, including typed UML artifacts and separate UI mockups. Lifecycle startup uses a metadata-only SQL index bounded to 3,000 UTF-8 bytes and at most 32 candidate entries, with complete stable ids, element type/name/parent/version and included/total counts. Descriptions, relationships, source, artifacts and bindings are loaded through explicit relevant retrieval. Omission metadata identifies incomplete context; the MCP never infers a task's meaning. Shared retrieval workflow is documented in agents_template.md and on-demand operation help. Implemented contract: editable design-document reads return stable document identity, the complete canonical editable document, and a server-computed content-hash readToken from the same snapshot. Agents copy the opaque token unchanged into an update or delete. Partial overviews, indexes, or search snippets are not complete editable snapshots; their guidance directs the agent to retrieve the complete document before replacing it. Explicit get_by_ids, get_scope, and get_bindings responses include documents entries; get_documents retrieves exact documentIds. Each entry contains documentId, document, and readToken. Overview and search remain navigation-only.

Approved Markdown extension (implementation pending): Extend get_overview, get_scope, get_by_ids, get_documents, get_bindings, search and adashi_grep with first-class markdown targets, meaningful title/body search snippets, scoped associations, direct bindings and drillable identities. A Markdown identity can be retrieved without a C4 parent; get_scope can open the document and its explicit links/backlinks. Existing generic documents entries return the entire Markdown editable object plus its opaque token from one snapshot. Overview/startup/search/list results remain bounded metadata or snippets with omission counts and retrieval pointers; do not inline all prose automatically. Task and QA retrieval must resolve markdown specification links, preserving opt-in expanded scopes. Generated paths are discovery hints only; fetch a fresh canonical document before editing. Ensure complete-body retrieval is never presented as complete if truncated.
